title: Going public with the find through Expressen

tellings.quote: So, I talked to a journalist here in Stockholm, Expressen is a big newspaper.

plain: Dennis Asberg, a Swedish treasure hunter who says his team found a strange object on the seafloor, says that in 2011 he went public with the find by talking to a journalist at Expressen, which he calls "a big newspaper" in Stockholm. He tells it as his own decision, and it is how word of the object first got out.
